description: Terminate one Gameye session by its exact ID (sends SIGTERM to the container). Any players connected to it are disconnected. The session transitions to 'draining' then 'shuttingdown' then 'exited'. There is no bulk or implicit stop: an empty, wildcard or list ID is refused. Pass dryRun=true to preview the request.

dryRun.description: Return the exact request that would be sent, with the API token masked, and send nothing

id.description: Exact ID of the one session to stop

name: gameye_stop_session
title: Stop session
